note: Small-commercial default generation from the utility tariff. Each figure is the tariff's stated energy charge plus its stated capacity charge for the small-commercial schedule. Duke Energy Ohio and AES Ohio have no commercial figure here because the apples-to-apples page for those schedules still prints the residential Price to Compare, and no separate commercial total was taken from a tariff.
